## Hooks

- `claude-ste-gate.sh` — lints the last output.
- `claude-ste-lint.py` — reads the config.
- `install.sh` — copies the files.

The scripts run in a set sequence.

- `uninstall.sh` — removes the files.
- `extract-dict.py` — builds a table.
- `agent-cap` — limits the count.
